identity.name: Culture Club
identity.mission: To connect the global fermentation community through shared knowledge and precise tracking.
principles: Content: The Ferment is the Hero
Zoom: Texture of bubbles, brine, and mold
Negative Space: Let the data breathe

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,300..700&family=Manrope:wght@300..800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');

usage_rules: Use Deep Ferment Green for primary actions and headers.
Use Kimchi Red sparingly for 'Active' states, Alerts, and Primary CTAs in dark mode.
Backgrounds should never be pure white in Light Mode; use #F5F5F1 (Cream).
Dark mode backgrounds should be #1A1D21 (Charcoal), not #000000.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain overlays on hero sections to evoke 'yeast/flour' texture.

layout_strategies.desktop: Masonry/Bento grid for feeds. Sidebar navigation.
layout_strategies.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 for grids.

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-6 font-semibold shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-8 py-6 border-2 border-[#354F52] text-[#354F52] hover:bg-[#354F52]/5 transition-all

cards.default: bg-card rounded-xl border border-border/50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300

inputs.style: h-12 rounded-lg border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Implement the 'Deep Ferment Green' and 'Kimchi Red' palette in tailwind.config.js. Ensure 'Fraunces' and 'Manrope' fonts are loaded.
3. LAYOUT: Build a 'Shell' component that handles the responsive navigation (Sidebar for desktop, Bottom Tab for mobile).
4. DASHBOARD: Create a 'Bento Grid' dashboard showing: Active Projects (Cards), Community Feed (List), and Quick Actions.
5. TRACKER: The Project Tracker is the core. Use a vertical timeline component for tracking stages (Prep, Ferment, Age, Done).
6. ANIMATION: Use framer-motion for page transitions and list entrance animations. 'staggerChildren' is mandatory for lists.
7. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components. Remove the default 'slate' look. Add border-radius 'rounded-xl'. Use the 'glassmorphism' style for sticky headers.
8. DATA-TESTID: Every interactive element (buttons, inputs, cards) MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., 'project-card-kimchi', 'nav-home').
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic AI designs. Be bold with typography (Fraunces).
Use 2-3x more padding than you think is necessary.
Always add hover states that lift elements (-translate-y-1).
